narrative:
## Handover Summary — Multi-Brand P&L

The October P&L is locked per chain, built from reconciled feeds after intercompany eliminations.

## Key Decisions
• Markdown reserve on aged summer outdoor stock in Intersport franchise stores
• Click-and-collect freight moved to the store-fulfilment rate card
• Anton Sport supplier marketing contributions reclassified to COGS

## Recommendation for CFO Sign-off
Sign off with the margin bridge to budget attached. The leadership deck can use the same governed numbers.

signals.title: Aged summer stock in franchise stores
signals.excerpt: NOK 9.8M of summer outdoor stock is older than 180 days. Markdown timing affects both group and store-owner margins.

signals.title: Leadership business case — data platform
signals.excerpt: A 10-slide leadership deck is being prepared to justify modernising the data platform. Month-end close reliability is the lead argument.
